info.name: GitHub Convert an Organization Member to Outside Collaborator

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: username
params.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

items.docs: When an organization member is converted to an outside collaborator, they'll only have access to the repositories that their current team membership allows. The user will no longer be a member of the organization. For more information, see "[Converting an organization member to an outside collaborator](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/articles/converting-an-organization-member-to-an-outside-collaborator/)".
